use_read_write_context: use the read_write context manager to temporarily modify a readonly OmegaConf configuration object
modify_omegaconf_config: modify an OmegaConf config by wrapping changes in the read_write context manager
toggle_readonly_config: toggle readonly and struct flags on an OmegaConf config using the read_write context
review_read_write_function: review the read_write context manager that safely enables temporary writes to OmegaConf configs
summarize_read_write: summarize the read_write function that temporarily disables readonly and struct flags on OmegaConf
